rationale: Roberts is best positioned to hold the 6-Justice coalition together by writing a narrow, administrable opinion rejecting a categorical moment-of-threat rule while limiting antecedent-conduct evidence to closely connected context relevant to the force decision. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters (to police the Mendez/negligence line) and from one or more majority Justices to either tighten the limiting principle (Barrett/Gorsuch) or emphasize accountability and totality-of-circumstances (Sotomayor/Jackson).
